  "meaningfully_distinct": true,
  "evidence_ids": ["E1.1"],
  "reasons": [
    "According to NCERT Macroeconomics (E1.1), revenue receipts are receipts that do not lead to a claim on the government and are non-redeemable, comprising tax and non-tax revenues.",
    "Corporation tax collected from firms never has to be returned, creating no liability or claim against the government, so it is a revenue receipt.",
    "Loans and redeemable securities (Options B, C, D) create repayment obligations (claims on the government) and are therefore capital receipts."
  ],
  "syllabus_chapter": "Government Budget & the Economy",
  "syllabus_topic": "Classification of receipts - revenue receipts and capital receipts",
  "syllabus_entitlement": true,
  "presentation_ready": true,
  "question_type_match": true,
  "principle_applicability": "excerpt_required",
  "decisive_principle_in_excerpts": true,
  "answer_conditions": [
    {
      "condition": "Revenue receipts are non-redeemable receipts that do not create a claim or liability on the government.",
      "status": "convention",
      "alters_key_if_changed": true,
      "convention_evidence_ids": ["E1.1"]
    }
  ],
  "option_challenges": [
    {
      "option": "B",
      "strongest_reading": "A loan raised by issuing bonds creates an obligation to repay on maturity, which directly defines a capital receipt rather than a revenue receipt.",
      "correct_under_reading": false,
      "reading_status": "contradicts_stem",
      "convention_evidence_ids": []
    },
    {
      "option": "C",
      "strongest_reading": "Foreign borrowings must be repaid with interest, creating a financial claim/liability against the government, which excludes them from revenue receipts.",
      "correct_under_reading": false,
      "reading_status": "contradicts_stem",
      "convention_evidence_ids": []
    },
    {
      "option": "D",
      "strongest_reading": "Securities redeemable after a fixed period represent redeemable debt, contradicting the essential non-redeemable criterion of revenue receipts.",
      "correct_under_reading": false,
      "reading_status": "contradicts_stem",
      "convention_evidence_ids": []
    }
  ],
  "blocking_defects": [],
  "style_notes": [],
  "cuet_fit": {
    "criteria": {
      "syllabus_objective": {
        "level": 3,
        "evidence": "Directly tests the syllabus classification of budget receipts into revenue and capital receipts."
      },
      "format_authenticity": {
        "level": 3,
        "evidence": "Standard single-stem multiple-choice question typical of CUET UG Economics."
      },
      "level_calibration": {
        "level": 3,
        "evidence": "Requires fundamental concept application aligned with Class 12 NCERT curriculum."
      },
      "discrimination_value": {
        "level": 3,
        "evidence": "Distinguishes students who understand the non-redeemable nature of revenue receipts from those who confuse them with borrowing."
      }
    },
    "reasoning_steps": 1,
    "estimated_difficulty": "easy",
    "cognitive_level": "comprehension",
    "exemplar_ids_compared": []
  },
  "option_resolution": [
    {
      "option": "A",
      "status": "supported",
      "false_part": "",
      "premise_source": "excerpt",
      "evidence_id": "E1.1",
      "premise_quote": "Revenue receipts are those receipts that do not lead to a claim on the government.",
      "reason": "Taxes create no claim and are non-redeemable revenue receipts."
    },
    {
      "option": "B",
      "status": "contradicted",
      "false_part": "that the government must repay on maturity",
      "premise_source": "excerpt",
      "evidence_id": "E1.1",
      "premise_quote": "Revenue receipts are those receipts that do not lead to a claim on the government.",
      "reason": "Repayable bonds create a claim on the government."
    },
    {
      "option": "C",
      "status": "contradicted",
      "false_part": "to be repaid with interest",
      "premise_source": "excerpt",
      "evidence_id": "E1.1",
      "premise_quote": "Revenue receipts are those receipts that do not lead to a claim on the government.",
      "reason": "Borrowings to be repaid create a claim on the government."
    },
    {
      "option": "D",
      "status": "contradicted",
      "false_part": "that are redeemable after a fixed period",
      "premise_source": "excerpt",
      "evidence_id": "E1.1",
      "premise_quote": "They are therefore termed non-redeemable.",
      "reason": "Revenue receipts must be non-redeemable."
    }
  ]
}
